name: skillora-showreel
description: 15-second Skillora motion graphics showreel, built with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run sfx && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run sfx && remotion render src/index.ts Showreel out/skillora-showreel.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 && remotion render src/index.ts ShowreelPortrait out/skillora-showreel-portrait.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:share: npm run sfx && remotion render src/index.ts Showreel out/skillora-showreel-share.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --max-rate 5M --buffer-size 10M --color-space bt709 --audio-bitrate 192k --props='{"grain":false}' && remotion render src/index.ts ShowreelPortrait out/skillora-showreel-portrait-share.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --max-rate 5M --buffer-size 10M --color-space bt709 --audio-bitrate 192k --props='{"grain":false}'
